title: Pyne Pod 2in1 Mixed Berries Ice Prefilled Vape Pods - Pod Salt Edition
description: This Mixed Berries Ice Pod Pack for the Pyne Pod 2-in-1 Kit blends a medley of juicy berries with a crisp cooling finish. The flavour opens with sweet and tangy notes from Strawberries, Raspberries, and Blueberries, layered to create a bright, fruity burst. A clean Ice element adds a brisk exhale that balances the sweetness with a refreshing chill. Each pod contains 2ml of 20mg nicotine salt e-liquid and is made for use with the Pyne Pod 2-in-1 device. The pods lock in magnetically and allow quick flavour changes via the twist-to-switch mouthpiece. With two pods per pack, Mixed Berries Ice is a dynamic all-day vape that works well alone or paired with tropical, mint, or citrus profiles.
